icm-stage validation passes and independent review verifies provenance and protected state; human visual approval remains mandatory.
stop_conditions: The trusted feature branch head no longer equals the task base SHA.
The primary reference image is unavailable, unreadable, or has an unexpected SHA-256.
The Hugging Face account is unauthenticated, inference cannot persist its output, or the next job could exceed the USD 3.50 aggregate cap.
No usable generated mesh seed results from the maximum permitted three generations.
